title: Nursery-Rib Ravager
text: Nursery-Rib Ravager guards a cage of translucent brood organs with hooked ribs and sudden lateral strikes. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: It carries the next generation where a heart should be.

defeatReward.text: Nursery-Rib Ravager is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
